title: The Future of Life Science Training with Novartis & Moderna
summary: A private customer session from LTEN 2025: Novartis and Moderna on cutting course creation from weeks to hours.
body_markdown: A private session for Arist customers, recorded at LTEN 2025. Executives from Novartis and Moderna on how they took course creation from six-plus weeks down to hours using AI, and scaled to deliver tens of thousands of courses across their field teams.
